# doc-bricks

doc-bricks is the document-work branch of the brick suite: local-first desktop tools for document libraries, Markdown reading, OCR, PDF export, mail attachment intake, invoice archiving, literature management, and personal knowledge workflows.

Canonical organization: https://github.com/doc-bricks
Organization profile repository: https://github.com/doc-bricks/.github
Related suite entry points: https://github.com/open-bricks, https://github.com/file-bricks, https://github.com/dev-bricks, https://github.com/ellmos-ai

Public repository directory updated: 2026-06-18. The public organization profile lists public GitHub repositories only; private or internal repositories are intentionally excluded from this crawler context.

## Primary repositories

- .github: https://github.com/doc-bricks/.github
  Organization profile, shared community-health files, issue templates, pull request template, security policy, and machine-readable organization context.
- DokuReader: https://github.com/doc-bricks/DokuReader
  Local-first document library with topic organization, previews, read status, PDF bundling, and metadata-only JSON export.
- CleanMarkdown: https://github.com/doc-bricks/CleanMarkdown
  Markdown viewer/editor with clean reading mode, raw editing, PDF export, session handoff, and PWA companion.
- LitZentrum: https://github.com/doc-bricks/LitZentrum
  Literature management suite for PDFs, BibTeX, JSON export, and academic reading workflows.
- UniversalDocsGrabber: https://github.com/doc-bricks/UniversalDocsGrabber
  Local IMAP and Gmail attachment downloader with OCR, PDF conversion, dedupe, and review workflows.
- UniversalMailCleaner: https://github.com/doc-bricks/UniversalMailCleaner
  Local-first Gmail and IMAP mailbox cleaner with safe trash mode, labels, scheduler, and large-item cleanup.
- UniversalInvoiceMail: https://github.com/doc-bricks/UniversalInvoiceMail
  Invoice and receipt extractor from IMAP and Gmail with OCR, PDF conversion, JSON export, and DATEV-oriented archive workflows.
- MailProcessor: https://github.com/doc-bricks/MailProcessor
  System tray launcher for the Universal Mail Tools family.
- MediaBrain: https://github.com/doc-bricks/MediaBrain
  Local media and document hub for files, browser activity, and research material.
- llm-note: https://github.com/doc-bricks/llm-note
  Local-first notes and notebook inboxes for LLM agents: SQLite note log, plain-text notebooks, CLI/Python API, six locales, and standalone agent skill.

## Positioning

- Local-first and privacy-conscious document tools.
- Desktop workflows for Windows and cross-platform Python environments.
- Human-readable and LLM-readable project documentation.
- Local-first note and handoff primitives for LLM-assisted workflows.
- Practical export formats such as PDF, JSON, BibTeX, and mail/document archive formats.
- No claim that external cloud processing is required by default.
